title: Tested baseline versus current ecosystem
summary: Allocator v0.6 remains runtime-qualified against the versions recorded in its own README/VALIDATION. The 2026-09-06 API roll-up contains newer neighbouring packages in some areas (including API Client v0.3, Security Effect v0.14, Access Permissions v0.2 and Queue Fabric v0.9-dev5). Presence in the newer roll-up is not evidence that allocator v0.6 was qualified against those newer interfaces.

provenance.claim: Current ecosystem roll-up retains the exact v0.6 allocator artifact.

invariants: Never silently upgrade a qualification claim from package presence alone.
Re-run allocator mesh/authority/dispatch tests before claiming compatibility with a newer neighbouring authority version.
